status: Uncalibrated inextensible planar beam approximation, not original EBiM physics or a full FEM reproduction
method: Discrete bending energy 0.5*k_theta*q^2, k_theta=EI/dual_length; MuJoCo passive hinge springs plus contact/friction; no capture force or weld
geometry_source: Approximate midlines traced from EBiM C-Clip.stl section at x=6.5 mm after source 0.01 scale; mounting base retained below z=1 mm; upper arm and lower lip use independent passive beam chains rooted at that base
parameter_status: Young modulus, density and damping are illustrative test parameters, not measured EBiM plastic values. Friction 0.25 taken from EBiM back/base proxy. Thickness and midline are section approximations.
